summary: Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) is a compact data format, and COSE defines how to sign, authenticate and encrypt data in it, plus how to represent cryptographic keys in CBOR. This document gives the structures and processing rules. Together with RFC 9053 it obsoletes RFC 8152.

eli5.summary: Think of a tiny sealed envelope for small gadgets. COSE tells devices how to sign and lock short messages so they stay safe while using very little space.

questions: how to sign and encrypt cbor data
